purpose: Track parser-repair attempts without confusing syntax recovery with S1/S2 semantic failure.

progress_rules.parser_pass: PASS is progress and closes parser-recovery only; it does not prove S1 or S2.
progress_rules.changed_blocker: A changed diagnostic fingerprint after a changed candidate source is FORWARD_RECOVERY_PROGRESS, not a semantic regression.
progress_rules.same_blocker_changed_source: The same blocker fingerprint across multiple changed candidate sources is STALLED_REPAIR when repeated at least three consecutive observed attempts.
progress_rules.same_source_same_blocker: Repeated observation on the exact same source is REOBSERVATION_ONLY, not progress or regression.
progress_rules.missing_diagnostic: A blocked parser without a diagnostic fingerprint remains BLOCKED_UNCLASSIFIED.

semantic_boundary: Parser recovery evidence may only affect EXPR_PARSER_SYNTAX. It must never set S1_TYPED_VALUES or S2_DEF_USE to FAIL/PASS by itself.
